'''Ryfus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who worked with the Damotit on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When Lanteeb was invaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]], Ryfus was attacked by [[Mosquito droid]]s and injured.
